method: Four separate whole-process profiles of the exact timed native binaries: Callgrind and DHAT for Imre and Rust. Includes process startup, input decoding, algorithm calls, accumulated checksum, and file I/O. Identical input and repetition counts; complete output and accumulated checksum checked after every run.
instruction_measurement: Callgrind guest instructions (Ir), not CPU cycles, CPU time, or wall-time speedup. Self costs partition total instructions; inclusive costs overlap.
allocation_measurement: DHAT requested heap bytes/blocks, not RSS. Peak totals use contributions at the same global peak. Exit-live values alone do not establish leaks.
